### Release Notes

<details>
<summary>moby/moby (github.com/moby/moby/api)</summary>

### [`v1.57.0`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/releases/tag/api/v1.57.0)

#### 1.57.0

##### Engine API specification moves to OpenAPI 3.2

> \[!WARNING]
> The Engine API specification now uses OpenAPI 3.2 as its source format, in [`api/openapi.yaml`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/blob/api/v1.57.0/api/openapi.yaml).
> A Swagger 2.0 specification generated from it is still published for existing tooling, in [`api/swagger.yaml`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/blob/api/v1.57.0/api/swagger.yaml).
> For the transition, this release also includes a Swagger 2.0 copy pinned to API v1.57, in [`api/docs/v1.57-swagger.yaml`](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/blob/api/v1.57.0/api/docs/v1.57-swagger.yaml).
> Future API versions won't get a per-version Swagger 2.0 copy, so update tooling that depends on these files to use the OpenAPI 3.2 specifications. [moby/moby#53630](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53630)

##### Changelog

- `GET /events`: Container `die` events now include a `restarting` attribute, set to `"true"` when the container is about to restart, either from its restart policy or from a manual restart. [moby/moby#50908](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/50908)
  The attribute is omitted when the container won't restart, including during daemon shutdown.
  It announces the restart but doesn't guarantee it, because the restart can still be cancelled or fail.
- Fix the `ImageManifestSummary.ImageData` schema, which listed `UnpackedSize` as required even though that field doesn't exist. The unpacked size is reported in `Size.Unpacked`. [moby/moby#53750](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53750)
- Migrate the Engine API specification from Swagger 2.0 to OpenAPI 3.2. [moby/moby#53630](https://redirect.github.com/moby/moby/pull/53630)

</details>
